typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		VERSIONNO as string,
		SETTLEEVENTINSTR_S as string,
		SETTLEORIGINALQTY as integer,
		TDAT as string,
		SETTLEDELIVERYTYPE_S as string,
		CLDR as string,
		VDAT as string,
		OPER as string,
		ISIN as string,
		GLOSSTRADEREF1 as string,
		SETTLEMENTSTATUSLAST as string,
		SETTLEOPENQTY_S as integer,
		ORIGIN as string,
		LOADDATETIME as string,
		TRADEID as string,
		TREF1 as string,
		PARTYLONGNAME1 as string,
		TREF as string,
		PBK as string,
		TRADETYPE as string,
		SETTLEDATE_S as timestamp,
		BLKE as string,
		SETTLEMENTSTATUSFIRST as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource1
OLEDBSource1 sink(input(
		VERSIONNO as string,
		SETTLEEVENTINSTR_S as string,
		SETTLEORIGINALQTY as integer,
		TDAT as string,
		SETTLEDELIVERYTYPE_S as string,
		CLDR as string,
		VDAT as string,
		OPER as string,
		ISIN as string,
		GLOSSTRADEREF1 as string,
		SETTLEMENTSTATUSLAST as string,
		SETTLEOPENQTY_S as integer,
		ORIGIN as string,
		LOADDATETIME as string,
		TRADEID as string,
		TREF1 as string,
		PARTYLONGNAME1 as string,
		TREF as string,
		PBK as string,
		TRADETYPE as string,
		SETTLEDATE_S as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		BLKE as string,
		SETTLEMENTSTATUSFIRST as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		VERSIONNO,
		SETTLEEVENTINSTR_S,
		SETTLEORIGINALQTY,
		TDAT,
		SETTLEDELIVERYTYPE_S,
		CLDR,
		VDAT,
		OPER,
		ISIN,
		GLOSSTRADEREF1,
		SETTLEMENTSTATUSLAST,
		SETTLEOPENQTY_S,
		ORIGIN,
		LOADDATETIME,
		TRADEID,
		TREF1,
		PARTYLONGNAME1,
		TREF,
		PBK,
		TRADETYPE,
		SETTLEDATE_S,
		BLKE,
		SETTLEMENTSTATUSFIRST),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
